# HiPRGen source snapshot

Unmodified files from [BlauGroup/HiPRGen](https://github.com/BlauGroup/HiPRGen), commit `a0dddfedc21be0121745e5f33f27ad8aafe796ea`. Upstream copyright and license are retained in [LICENSE](LICENSE). These third-party files are attributed to their original authors.

The local audit executes the complete upstream `bucket()` and `run_decision_tree()` function definitions through a restricted AST loader, avoiding unrelated optional imports. A compatible KEEP/DISCARD enum and project-specific filters are supplied. This is a limited function-level pilot, not installation or execution of the full MPI/species-thermochemistry pipeline. Source files are not modified, and result metadata records their hashes.
